configuration.architectureReduction: official source is hidden=2048, heads=16/2, headDim=256, expert intermediate=512, shared intermediate=512, experts=256, topK=8, layers=40; this fixture instantiates only full-attention layer 3 at hidden=32, heads=2/1, headDim=32, intermediate=8, while retaining experts=256 and topK=8
